steps.title: Brows
steps.howTo: Fill any gaps with light strokes in your brow colour and brush them into place.

steps.title: Mascara
steps.howTo: One or two coats from the roots up. Waterproof mascara stops watering eyes from smudging it.

steps.title: Cheeks and lips
steps.howTo: Sweep soft pink blush along your cheekbones and finish with a nude lip. Put on lip balm first.

steps.howTo: Blend foundation in your shade with a little more coverage, then concealer under the eyes and anywhere you need it. Moisturise first and use a hydrating base.

steps.howTo: Pat shimmery bronze shadow on the lid, smudge a deeper brown under the eye, and draw a soft wing.

steps.howTo: Build mascara in two or three coats, then shape your brows a little more defined. Waterproof mascara stops watering eyes from smudging it.
products: brow pencil in your brow colour

steps.title: Warmth and glow
steps.howTo: Dust a little bronzer where the sun would hit and highlighter on the high points.

steps.title: Soft cheeks
steps.howTo: A light sweep of soft pink blush, so the eyes lead.

steps.title: Soft lips
steps.howTo: A nude lipstick, pressed on with a fingertip. Put on lip balm first.
